elements.text:
SERVER TALKER ARBITRATION
First AUDIO sender gets the talker slot
Other senders’ audio is dropped
Release slot after > 300 ms silence
Forward active audio to all other clients
Forward payload unchanged (no decrypt)

elements.text:
MODE SWITCHES
--rx-only / --no-ptt: no keyboard thread or mic capture; send worker still sends IDLE.
--blackfiber-rx-passive: also disables send worker. --blackfiber-tx-only: disables receive worker. These two flags are mutually exclusive.
An explicitly enabled PTT socket still runs in receive-only modes and can suppress playback, even though microphone TX is disabled.

elements.text:
STATE & SHUTDOWN
--state-file: atomic file replacement with TX/RX flags, local txid, remote talker, and timestamps; updates on state transitions.
SIGINT / SIGTERM → clear running → join workers → stop/release pipelines → close sockets → write idle state → unlink control socket → wipe key.
Packet counters and talker / PTT transitions are logged to the console.
